text_run.content: This operation alters the specified collection properties.

alter_collection_properties(
    self, 
    collection_name: str, 
    properties: dict, 
    timeout: Optional[float] = None, 
    **kwargs
The name of the target collection.
The properties and their new values in a dictionary. Possible dictionary keys are as follows:
The time-to-live (TTL) of a collection in seconds.
Whether to enable mmap for the raw data and indexes of all fields in the collection. For details, refer to <include target="milvus">
Whether to enable partition key isolation. For details, refer to <include target="milvus">
Whether to enable the dynamic field. For details, ref
Whether to allow a collection to accept user-provided primary key values when AutoID has been enabled for the collection.
: Inserts, upserts, and bulk imports use the user-provided primary key if present; otherwise, primary key values are auto-generated.
: User-provided primary key values are rejected or ignored and primary key values are always auto-generated. The default is
Sets a default time zone for your collection. The value must be a valid
The timeout duration for this operation.
Setting this to None indicates that this operation timeouts when any response arrives or any error occurs.
This exception will be raised when any error occurs during this operation, especially when the specified alias does not exist.

client = MilvusClient(
    uri="http://localhost:19530",
    token="root:Milvus"
)

# upsert properties
properties = {"collection.ttl.seconds": 500, "mmap.enabled": true}

client.alter_collection_properties(
    collection_name="collection_name", 
    properties = properties
